claims.statement: For the baseline signed diagonal row Hessian, a seed requires epsilon_g^2 > 3 epsilon_H^2. This is sufficient only for unrestricted real row vectors, not native graph reachability or represented-number existence.

All ten unchanged frozen P9-10.4 expansion policies exclude geometric seeds. Their D52 targets also exclude thirteen of seventeen nodes by empty fixed rows. Neither result excludes a separately justified completion criterion.
The accepted separately identified C_OS seed example provides one positive local diagnostic, with no event, child gain or temporal stability claim.
